request.prompt: A deep London Underground station escalator shaft, seen from the top looking down the long bank of three parallel escalators. Brushed-steel balustrades, warm bronze uplighter lamps between the escalators, cream tiled tunnel walls and ceiling curving overhead, a few commuters with bags riding up and down in soft focus. Directional signs hang overhead but their writing is blurred and unreadable. Warm, slightly golden station light. Photorealistic, shot on a cinema camera with a 35mm lens, natural London light, high-end commercial colour grade, fine film grain. One single continuous photograph, not a collage. No readable text, no logos, no brand names, no watermarks.
